title: SpaceX has officially acquired AI coding startup Cursor - Engadget
summary: Shortly after the new name was announced, the companies released Grok 4.5 , the first model SpaceXAI and Cursor built together. Cursor said Grok 4.6 provides an early look at what it can build together with SpaceXAI.
